summary: Seven games were played on Sunday, and the road team won four of them. Dallas beat Brooklyn 130-93, the largest margin at 37 points, while Austin Reaves scored a night-high 43 as the Lakers beat Detroit 121-116 after leading by 26. Boston overcame a 14-point deficit to beat Milwaukee 117-97, and Miami held off Sacramento 114-108 after the Kings tied it at 95-95 in the fourth quarter.

games.headline: 76ers hold off Bulls 127-121 behind Brown and Maxey
games.story: Philadelphia led 68-61 at halftime and went ahead for good at 71-68 early in the third quarter, building its biggest lead of 12 at 97-85. Chicago stayed within 2 in the fourth quarter but never regained the lead. Jaylen Brown scored 29 points, Tyrese Maxey had 27 and LeBron James added 22 for the 76ers, who made 14 of 34 threes. Josh Giddey had 19 points and 15 assists and Matas Buzelis scored 19 for the Bulls, who were without Norman Powell.

games.headline: Reaves scores 43 as Lakers outlast Pistons 121-116
games.story: Los Angeles scored 38 points in the first quarter to lead 38-14, and the lead reached 26 at 40-14 in the second. Detroit outscored the Lakers in each of the last three quarters and cut the gap to 1 in the fourth, but never led. Austin Reaves scored 43 points on 14-of-27 shooting and Walker Kessler had 12 points and 16 rebounds. Daniss Jenkins made eight threes for 31 points for the Pistons, who were without Jalen Duren, and the Lakers did not have Luka Doncic.

games.headline: Timberwolves pull away from Jazz 115-100 in the third
games.story: The game was tied seven times, the last at 63-63 early in the third quarter, and Minnesota went ahead for good at 66-63. The Timberwolves led 90-78 after three and reached 19 at 115-96 late in the fourth. Ayo Dosunmu scored 26 points and LaMelo Ball had 24 for Minnesota, which was without Anthony Edwards. Darryn Peterson scored 26 for Utah, which did not have Lauri Markkanen, and Minnesota made 12 threes to the Jazz's 7.

games.headline: Mavericks lead all the way, beat Nets 130-93
games.story: After a 2-2 tie in the opening minute, Dallas led for the rest of the game. The Mavericks were up 66-46 at halftime and 100-71 after three quarters, and the margin reached 37 at the final buzzer. Cooper Flagg had 25 points, 5 rebounds and 12 assists, Kyrie Irving scored 21 and Daniel Gafford had 18 on 7-of-8 shooting. Brooklyn shot 31 of 80 from the field, and Michael Porter Jr. led the Nets with 19 points and 9 rebounds.

games.headline: Celtics erase 14-point deficit, rout Bucks 117-97
games.story: Milwaukee led 20-6 early in the first quarter, but Boston outscored the Bucks 33-18 in the second and went ahead for good at 28-27 early in that period. The Celtics led 58-45 at halftime and by as many as 23 at 70-47 in the third quarter. Paul George scored 27 points on 11-of-18 shooting and Jayson Tatum had 21 points and 6 rebounds. Kyle Kuzma scored 27 for the Bucks with six threes, and Milwaukee shot 35 of 79 overall.

games.headline: Clippers pull away from Pelicans 139-123 in the fourth
games.story: New Orleans led by as many as 4, and the game was tied seven times before Los Angeles went ahead for good at 94-93 late in the third quarter. The Clippers led 102-95 after three and reached 20 at 135-115 with under two minutes left. Darius Garland had 24 points and 10 assists for the Clippers, who made 16 threes and had 34 assists, and they were without Bradley Beal and Brandon Ingram. Trey Murphy III scored 26, Jeremiah Fears 25 and Zion Williamson 25 on 9-of-9 shooting for New Orleans.

games.headline: Heat hold off Kings 114-108 behind Giannis and Klay
games.story: Miami led by 16 at 75-59 early in the third quarter, but Sacramento came back and tied it at 95-95 with 6:12 left in the fourth. The Heat went ahead again at 98-95 and stayed in front. Giannis Antetokounmpo scored 29 points with 14 rebounds and Klay Thompson made seven threes for 23 points. Darius Acuff Jr. scored 32 points with 10 assists for the Kings, who were without Domantas Sabonis.
